scope: AC1021 BLOCK_CONTROL common-handle reactors; reader preservation and conservative DXF export refusal

specification.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
specification.claim: Common object reactor references precede the optional extension dictionary in the handles stream; BLOCK_CONTROL then contains the declared block-record handles and model/paper block references. Relative H6/H8/HA/HC forms resolve as soft pointers.

witness.authored_change: BLOCK_RECORD TABLE handle F0, ACAD_REACTORS reference 33 (existing named object dictionary)
witness.producer: ODA File Converter 27.1.0 macOS ARM64, ACAD2007 DWG output
witness.after: libdxfrw read succeeded, operationSucceeded=true, BAD_NONE (0); DXF output refused before write because the source reactor graph has no validated output route
witness.sentinel: An existing output file containing preserve-sentinel remained byte-identical after failed CLI export; exit status 1.

focused_checks.cases: Generated aligned and unaligned handle boundaries; zero and two reactors; optional extension dictionary; declared and model/paper references; invalid reactor role, oversized and truncated handle, 64-bit value outside uint32; reset and same-instance retry; H6/H8/HA/HC relative reference resolution. Oversized declared count with insufficient remaining bits is rejected before allocation, followed by same-instance retry.

compatibility_and_limits: Reactor capture and export gate are scoped to AC1021 BLOCK_CONTROL; no new public interface virtual or object data member is added.

The optional existing frame-publication channel carries the bounded reactor vector. dx_iface conservatively refuses output when the captured graph has nonzero reactors or capture failed; this is not a claim of reactor graph closure.

The no-reactor ODA physical control imports successfully; its strict CLI export independently fails the existing complete-read-disposition gate, so this witness does not establish complete-file output support.
The local generated witness and ODA DWG are scratch artifacts and are not committed. Producer output bytes may vary by application version or save session.
